request: Fix inventory.py set_quantity(item_id, quantity). Integer IDs and their decimal-string form refer to the same existing integer-key item. Reject boolean IDs and negative/non-integer quantities with ValueError; unknown IDs raise KeyError. Never create duplicate string-key items. Preserve label().
